threat_event: Ransomware operator uses the integrator remote tool at an acquired farm to reach ROC SCADA and the corporate network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on remote tool; one shared account; no MFA; no monitoring of the tool
treatment_plan: Remove the tool; integrator sessions only through group PAM on request with named accounts and MFA
owner: Crop Farming OT security manager

threat_event: Attacker takes over the legacy farm operations directory and controls all ROC HMIs and SCADA servers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 11 domain administrators outside group PAM; no MFA; events not sent to the SIEM
affected_asset_or_process: Legacy farm operations directory; ROC-1 to ROC-3
treatment_plan: Administrators under group PAM with MFA; directory logs to the SIEM; reduce administrators to 4
owner: Crop Farming OT security manager

threat_event: Freeze protection fails on a freeze night because ROC-1 SCADA is encrypted or unavailable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No warm standby for ROC-1; no written manual start procedure at acquired farms
affected_asset_or_process: ROC-1; overhead freeze protection on about 4,200 acres
existing_controls: Hand-Off-Auto switches; experienced freeze crews at legacy farms
treatment_plan: Written and drilled manual procedure at all ROC-1 farms by 2026-11-15; warm standby at ROC-2 by 2027-06-30
owner: Crop Farming VP Irrigation and Field Technology

threat_event: Attacker on the corporate cloud network reaches ROC SCADA through the farm data hub
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hub sits on the corporate cloud network and can open connections into ROC SCADA; no OT DMZ
existing_controls: Landing-zone guardrails; EDR on the hub
treatment_plan: OT DMZ at each ROC; hub reads DMZ replicas only
owner: Crop Farming OT security manager

threat_event: Malicious or unapproved change to fertigation rates or limits over-applies nutrients or chemicals
threat_source: Malicious insider; attacker with SCADA access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No change control or range limits at acquired farms; FMIS module changes unreviewed
existing_controls: Range limits in SCADA at legacy farms; physical injection limits on some skids
treatment_plan: Change control for all setpoint and limit changes; range limits at all farms; weekly change review
owner: Crop Farming VP Irrigation and Field Technology

threat_event: Shared crew logins make harvest tally and Produce Safety entries unattributable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Crew leads share logins at 21 farms
existing_controls: Supervisor review of tally each day
treatment_plan: Named crew lead accounts with tablet PINs before the 2026-27 harvest
owner: Crop Farming labor compliance director

threat_event: Seasonal FMIS accounts stay active after season end and are misused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 1,140 seasonal accounts active in July 2026; not tied to HR events
existing_controls: Accounts only work on managed tablets
treatment_plan: HR season-end events disable FMIS accounts automatically; monthly stale account report
owner: Crop Farming labor compliance director

threat_event: Attacker logs in to pivot panel modems with default credentials and starts or stops pivots
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default credentials on 18% of sampled modems; carrier private network access lists never reviewed
treatment_plan: Change all modem credentials; carrier access list review; quarterly credential scan
owner: Crop Farming OT security manager

threat_event: H-2A onboarding exports (passport and visa data) stored on the farm data hub are stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Copies of H-2A onboarding exports staged on the hub outside their system of record
treatment_plan: Exports purged on 2026-07-28 and the export job removed; data map review each quarter
owner: Crop Farming labor compliance director

threat_event: Harvest lot records cannot be produced for Food Processing and buyers within 24 hours during an outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single nightly file through the hub; paper lot tags inconsistent across farms
regulatory_driver: Buyer agreements (24-hour terms); supports 21 CFR 1.361 at Food Processing
existing_controls: Paper lot tags at legacy farms
treatment_plan: Signed lot manifests per load; quarterly drill with Food Processing
owner: Crop Farming Director of Food Safety

threat_event: FMIS vendor outage during harvest stops tally, records, and the irrigation module
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One tenant for all farms; vendor RTO 8 hours; no farm-held export
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 report; paper tally cards
treatment_plan: Monthly export; paper fallback kits at each farm
owner: Crop Farming security and compliance lead

threat_event: Yield model over-estimates drive forward sales and crew planning, then hours are cut at short notice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No change control; new varieties under-represented in training data
treatment_plan: Validation gate; caps on commitments; hours-offered checks (P10)
owner: Crop Farming VP Agronomy

threat_event: GNSS spoofing or RTK base station tampering misguides equipment and sprayers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Base stations at farm sites with default settings
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; base station settings reviewed yearly
owner: Crop Farming security and compliance lead

threat_event: Compromised drone fleet account flies spray drones outside approved areas
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Fleet admin accounts behind SYS-G1 since 2026; legacy pilot accounts remain
treatment_plan: Remove legacy pilot accounts; geofence change approval
owner: Crop Farming VP Irrigation and Field Technology

threat_event: Dealer technicians with standing telematics access misuse operator location histories
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing dealer access; location histories kept indefinitely
treatment_plan: Access on request; 2-year retention for location history
owner: Crop Farming security and compliance lead

threat_event: Exploitation of unpatched HMIs and SCADA servers at acquired farms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HMIs at 6 acquired farms on an unsupported operating system; never patched
treatment_plan: Replace unsupported HMIs (2027); isolate until replaced; quarterly patching
owner: Crop Farming OT security manager

threat_event: Vulnerable OT devices are not found because farm OT is not inventoried or scanned
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inventory from integrator spreadsheets at acquired farms; OT not in group vulnerability management
existing_controls: FMIS asset records; passive discovery at 9 farms
treatment_plan: Complete inventory; passive discovery at all farms; OT vulnerability management
owner: Crop Farming OT security manager

threat_event: Attack on farm OT is not detected at the 29 farms without OT monitoring
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Passive OT monitoring at 9 of 38 farms
treatment_plan: Sensors at all ROCs and farms by 2027-06-30
owner: Crop Farming OT security manager

threat_event: Buyer 24-hour notice missed after an incident that affects lots or volumes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Buyer notice terms not in the incident matrix
treatment_plan: Add buyer rows to the matrix (P08); contact list in the incident binder
owner: Crop Farming Director of Food Safety

threat_event: Cooler temperature alarms fail and produce warms undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Alarm path depends on cellular links and the FMIS
treatment_plan: Standalone alarm dialers at coolers
owner: Crop Farming Director of Food Safety

threat_event: Pesticide application records are altered or lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Edits allowed after submission; no review of the audit trail
treatment_plan: Lock records after sign-off; monthly audit trail review
owner: Crop Farming Director of Food Safety

threat_event: Lost or stolen harvest tablet exposes cached tally data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3,400 tablets in the field
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low
owner: Crop Farming labor compliance director

threat_event: Phishing of farm office staff and crew leads
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security awareness module in Spanish for crew leads; shared devices
treatment_plan: Spanish awareness module at pre-season meetings; phishing exercises for office staff
owner: Crop Farming security and compliance lead

threat_event: Disgruntled worker changes irrigation at an HMI on a farm
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pump houses at acquired farms padlocked with shared keys; HMIs stay signed in
treatment_plan: Badge locks at acquired farm pump houses
owner: Crop Farming VP Irrigation and Field Technology

threat_event: Flow meter records for water use permits are lost or altered
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Records in the historian and FMIS only
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low
owner: Crop Farming security and compliance lead

threat_event: Hurricane or long power loss at ROC-1 during freeze or harvest season
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No standby ROC
treatment_plan: Warm standby at ROC-2 (CF-003)
owner: Crop Farming VP Irrigation and Field Technology

threat_event: Soil probe or LoRaWAN data is spoofed so irrigation schedules over- or under-water
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Some gateways keep vendor admin passwords
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; gateway passwords changed with CF-008
owner: Crop Farming OT security manager

threat_event: Integrator works without security terms, oversight, or incident notice duties
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Time-and-materials agreement without security terms
treatment_plan: Security schedule in the agreement; named technicians; incident notice in 24 hours
owner: Crop Farming security and compliance lead

threat_event: Wrong payroll tally export underpays H-2A workers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tally export staged on the hub with no reconciliation
treatment_plan: Control totals per crew; weekly reconciliation with farm offices
owner: Crop Farming labor compliance director

threat_event: Imagery store exposed publicly, showing workers in fields
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guardrails block public buckets
treatment_plan: Accepted at Very Low
owner: Crop Farming VP Agronomy
